task.description: Diagnose GitHub #457 / ISS-0145: tests/integration files relying on ambient tenant_context ordering cause severe standalone -svc/-env failures. Audit all tests/integration/*.zig files with a local makePool() helper for missing tenant_context.set()/.clear() calls, verify reachability from main_test.zig/build.zig, and produce a precise fix scope.
acceptance_criteria: Every affected file identified with method reproducible
Reachability verified against build.zig/main_test.zig before scoping the fix

result.summary: Audited 88 files with local makePool(). 56 confirmed-bug (never call tenant_context), 3 partial (call it only after fixture-setup acquires), 29 already safe. Reachability check against build.zig/main_test.zig excluded 3 of the 56 (iss0076_secrets_table_test.zig safe via TestHarness.init() ordering; oidc31/oidc08 unreachable dead code, cross-referenced to existing GitHub #439). Final fix scope: 49 files.
